propositions: Link-sync tests currently exercise only a single representative relation (blocks) with mechanical assertions, leaving gaps in coverage of the full relation vocabulary including depends_on and relates_to.
Bug c8ed (outbound depends_on link direction swap) shipped undetected because the relation vocabulary coverage was incomplete and the semantic roundtrip oracle is gated behind live Jira.

Test parametrization must cover all 6 relations: 3 mapped relations (blocks→Blocks/False, depends_on→Blocks/True, relates_to→Relates/False) asserting exact (type, swap) tuples, and 3 unmapped relations (duplicates, supersedes, discovered_from) asserting empty mutation lists.
An untested branch exists in the REMOVE path's inward/outward direction logic for outward Blocks links whose local depends_on dependencies were removed.
